name: Single-Row Coordinate-Fibre Shrinking Does Not Repair the 267-Concept Obstruction
statement: Across the six unordered two-row coordinate presentations of the labelled $267$-concept obstruction, keep the two constant rows fixed and delete from either enlarged row one nonempty coordinate-trace fibre disjoint from their intersection. The $7148$ distinct outputs, with between one and $56$ deleted words, are all nonample. Of these, $5886$ have a corner. Each output has an explicit support that is shattered but not strongly shattered.
proof: The source enumeration canonicalizes every eligible single-row trace-fibre deletion across all six presentations. A first checker finds no ample output by shadow cardinality and records all corner counts. An independent verifier reconstructs each output and supplies a support that is shattered without being strongly shattered; for a set family this violates ampleness. A separate positivity pass agrees on all 7,148 cases.
comments: This excludes the stated batch deletions only. It does not cover arbitrary deletions, simultaneous changes to both rows, or repairs by insertion; the unresolved order interval remains 64 through 267.
